tagline: High-Current. Ultra-Slim. All-Terrain. Our commercial-grade TOPCon solar module delivers 180W with unique dual-cell parallel design for uninterrupted energy yields under shading, high temperatures and narrow spaces.
tech: N-Type 16BB 182mm monocrystalline silicon · SMBB super multi-busbar · Dual-cell parallel circuit
metaDescription: Callsun CN180W custom N-type TOPCon solar module for RV, truck, off-grid, marine and narrow-space applications. IP68, 5400Pa snow load, 25-year linear power warranty, up to 30% bifacial gain.
seoTitle: 180W Custom N-Type TOPCon Solar Module | Callsun
warranty: 10-year product material and workmanship warranty; 25-year linear power performance guarantee (84.5% output at year 25; 1% first-year degradation + 0.4%/year linear)
benefits: Flagship N-type TOPCon Technology — Industry-leading N-type TOPCon cell technology with record cell efficiency, lower degradation rates and exceptional long-term power generation reliability.

30% Bifacial Power Gain — Advanced bifacial technology with transparent backsheet captures reflected light from white RV roofs, sand or boat decks; delivers up to 30% additional energy in extreme environments.

Excellent Low Temperature Coefficient — Class-leading -0.30%/K temperature coefficient maintains peak voltage output in scorching deserts or intense summer heat, significantly reducing summer power drop-offs.

Dual-Cell Parallel Circuitry for Shade Resilience — Innovative dual-cell parallel design lets the panel operate as two independent units; even if partially shaded by branches or vents, the unaffected half continues full power output.

All-Terrain, All-Weather Protection — IP68 dust and water resistance, withstands 35mm hail impacts and high-speed highway vibrations; endures high humidity, severe cold and heavy rain for decades of off-grid adventure.
Dual Quality Assurance — 10-year product material and workmanship warranty plus 25-year linear power performance guarantee safeguard your high-value energy assets.
description: Callsun CN180W is a 180W custom N-type TOPCon solar module engineered for B2B distributors, RV manufacturers and EPC installers who need compact, slim, high-output modules for mobile, off-grid and space-limited deployments. Dual-cell parallel circuit provides shade resilience, and IP68 + 5400Pa mechanical load rating handles all-terrain all-weather conditions.
